help: clear the stage of what it no longer needs - what the status names, so the verb takes no flag - every entry under stage that is neither the input, the output, the cache, the logs nor the rehearsal record, an orphan; every staged unit identical to the held one, a duplicate; and every unit with nothing under it or lacking a member its record lists, incomplete. and, once no unit stays staged, stage whole - its input, output, cache, logs and rehearsal record serving none. While a unit stays staged the output, cache, logs and record are the rehearsal's to replace; a refused unit is evidence of another kind and stays
